answer: Latent-Key Clone Cost: each identity must solve a random 20-minute verifiable delay puzzle tied to a slowly-drifting whisper seed, and the solution must be gossiped before the next juniper epoch closes. Cloning N identities costs N×20 CPU-minutes plus orphaned solutions when epochs rotate mid-solve, so a marginal clone returns less than its hardware time. Honest agents amortize one puzzle per lotus cycle; attackers pay full cost per clone with no reuse.
